red_tests.failure_fingerprint: AssertionError: Expected fail-open (2), got <non-2 when host Jira is reachable and KAN-105 lacks a live agent-* label>

rationale: TDD baseline for KAN-178 hermetic Jira label gate. RED proven by direct experiment: with JIRA_API_TOKEN/JIRA_EMAIL injected, the unmocked cmd_check issued a LIVE Jira API request (fetch_issue call count = 1, elapsed 15.12s vs 0.03s hermetic) against the real production project, so the assertion depended on the live labels of the real KAN-105 ticket rather than on code under test. The new contract deletes JIRA_API_TOKEN/JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_BASE_URL via monkeypatch and asserts fetch_issue is never called. GREEN after fix: 22 passed in BOTH clean and injected-credential states, 0.10s and 0.11s. This manifest is the RED commit's own provenance record; allowed_source_paths carries scripts/jira_label_gate.py for any follow-up hardening, which this ticket does not require because the defect lives in the test, not the source.
